trace.name: commute
trace.text:
On the way to work

The street corner coffee cart vendor remembers your face: "Hey neighbor, fresh cinnamon twist just came out of the box, take one on the house today!"

The warm pastry and genuine smile set an upbeat, grounded tone for the morning.

Arrive at work

trace.name: work
trace.text:
Your shift

The breakroom microwave hums with the scent of reheated soup. The vending machine swallows a crumpled dollar bill without dispensing pretzels. You sit on a hard plastic chair, massaging your cramped calves until the buzzer rings.

The warehouse team smashes the quarterly dispatch record by 4:30 PM. The shift lead calls an early pack-up with full shift wages guaranteed. A palpable buzz of accomplishment fills the locker room as everyone packs their bags.

Complete shift
